description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). Addresses WEAK signal quality: tool_description_safety shows only 3 distinct scores across all inputs (range 50-100), meaning it fails to discriminate between MCPs. Must read MULTIPLE metadata fields (registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars) to produce differentiated scores. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Must complete each call in under 2 seconds. Return evidence dict listing fields used and partial scores.
